name: 儿童纯棉翻领短袖Polo衫款
description: 纯棉翻领童装Polo，修身版型不紧绷，三色可选清爽过夏

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm near-white #FDFDFA for packshot and macro, misty periwinkle blue #ACB7D0 for benefit and closing panels, pale grey-blue #D6DDE8 for scene and spec screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight studio lighting, front-left key, gentle skimming light for texture shots, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale wood planks #D6DDE8-toned and smooth matte paper board in #FDFDFA
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single slate accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, garment always fully spread or neatly presented, consistent scale
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh airy kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm near-white #FDFDFA, misty periwinkle blue #ACB7D0, pale grey-blue #D6DDE8 and slate text #4B5159; bright soft daylight studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle skimming light for texture and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style in slate; clean bright childrenswear photography mixed with airy infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1蓝底海报款「夏季新款短袖/时尚百搭」+灰白条纹男模特半身；屏2三段编号卖点(肩部/背部/弧形下摆)配Polo衫线稿图标；屏3白蓝分栏+灰色横幅「轻奢柔顺」+男模特重复图；屏4白底版型拆解(饱满肩部/简约领型/修饰腰身/胸围宽亮/弧形下摆六边形标注)+产品信息表；屏5产品参数表(品名纯棉时尚短袖、面料纯棉、颜色白黑灰、版型贴身标准宽松)+尺码表(尺码110-160，衣长44-60、胸围35*2-46*2、肩宽34-38、袖长39-57)；屏6仅剩灰色底与「加入会员」二维码角标。品类判定：源夹名「男装」但尺码表以110-160身高码为行、衣长44-60cm、肩宽34-38cm，属儿童身高段尺码体系，且版型标注为修身童装Polo，故改判为 母婴/童装，leaf=儿童纯棉翻领短袖Polo衫（屏1/3的成人模特图与童装尺码矛盾，以参数区品名与尺码表硬证据为准）。已剥离：原品牌英文字标、店铺会员角标与二维码、模特面容与身份、原文案原句、尺码表全部实测数值、版型/柔软/弹力等自评参数（一律改为 {callout_n} 或空白占位）。与近似模版差异（对比 registry 母婴/童装段39件）：1) 色板全新——雾霭蓝 #ACB7D0 / 暖白 #FDFDFA / 浅灰蓝 #D6DDE8 / 板岩灰 #4B5159 均未在童装段与男装段出现过；2) 背景体系为雾蓝纯色面板+浅灰蓝墙面+空白表格卡片，不用库内已有的天蓝云朵涂鸦、薰衣草灰垂布或木地板挂拍体系；3) 道具体系用六边形版型标注框+空白尺码表卡片+空白胶囊按钮，避开库内的衣架/帆布鞋/云朵线条；4) 机位桶以 straight-on / slight 3/4 / 90度俯拍 / high 45-degree / macro 五桶轮换，角色序列 HERO>HERO>DETAIL>SCENE>DETAIL>VARIANT>TRUST>CTA 与库内同leaf件（卷边袖字母T恤 HERO>DETAIL>DETAIL>SCENE…）不同；5) 三色 variant 采用 #FBFBF9/#27272B/#8B8F96 hex-pin，与库内任何色卡不重复。
